title: Programmer- PL
description:
Job title: Programmer
  
  
Reporting to – Technical Head &Technical Director
  
  
Location: Noida/Kolkata (Open for all India travel)
  
  
**Who We Are**
We are an ERP-led business transformation and implementation organization focused on helping clients move fromfragmented processes and systems to integrated, standardized and best-practice-driven operations.
  
  
**Our Approach To ERP Implementation Has Two Key Tracks**

* Industry Best Practices &ERP TransformationWe evaluate the client’s existing processes against relevant industry and functional best practices and enable thesethrough leading ERP platforms such as SAP and Microsoft Dynamics. The objective is not simply to implementsoftware, but to establish standardized processes, controls and operating models that reflect proven industrypractices.
* Sustained Organizational ChangeERP implementation also requires sustained organizational transformation and change management. We work withthe client to embed the new processes, behaviours and practices into the day-to-day working habits of theirworkforce. This ensures that the implemented solution delivers lasting business value rather than becoming only atechnology implementation.

OUR CLIENT SEGMENT
  
  
**The Role Will Support Clients Across Three Broad Segments**
 Multinational companies operating in India and other regions.
  
  
 Large Indian corporates with complex and diverse finance operations.
  
  
 Fast-growing, family-owned and professionally managed mid-sized businesses, generally in the ₹200–800crore range
  
  
OUR FOCUS AREAS
  
  
Our clients typically come from non-ERP or fragmented-system environments, where business processes may bemanaged through standalone applications or disconnected modular systems across departments.
  
  
Currently Acxiom implements multi technology ERP and business application projects for large MNC clients acrossmultiple countries. Such projects are based on the hub and spoke architecture where SAP / MS Dynamics isimplemented with multiple surround application like CRM portals and mobile apps built-in all Tier-1 technologystacks. Therefore, we are looking for Full Stack Developers who have designed and developed complex businessapplications on any of the prevalent programming languages like Dotnet platform, Java platform, Oracle stack, PHP,iOS and Android platforms.
  
  
We therefore help clients transition towards integrated enterprise processes. Functional Knowhow may be on areassuch as:
  
  
 Order to Cash Cycle
  
  
 Procure to Pay cycles
  
  
 Taxation
  
  
 Inventory, Supply chain & Production
  
  
 Sales & PO
  
  
 Reporting
  
  
 Cross-functional process integration
  
  
**Role, Scope &responsibilities**
Programmers for Acxiom Works for systems to customize, integrate, and maintain complex enterprise softwareUnlike general software developers, they build business logic, automate workflows, and connect databases.
  
  
Specialize in back-office systems for any ERP like SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O (Finance and Operations). Theymay be utilised in WMS, Portal Development or Mobile app.
  
  
 Business Programmer who has written software for inventory, production, accounts, payroll kind of businessprocesses and has designed both database and front end, and also has exposure of optimizing the design forperformance and removing application bottlenecks
  
  
 Design, Develop, customize different ERPs/Systems for FMCG, Manufacturing, Jewellery, Retail etc domainson Microsoft technologies
  
  
 Customization: Writing code to alter out-of-the-box system features to fit unique Industry Processes
  
  
 Develop SSRS reports, customized modules, and integrations for diverse industries including Pharmaceutical,Law Firms, Automotive, Production, Retail, Jewellery etc.
  
  
 Data Migration: Building custom tools Enhance data migration efficiency through the creation of optimizeddata mapping and staging tables during integrations of Cloud based ERP with legacy systems.
  
  
 Deliver end-to-end integration projects, including requirement analysis, solution design, implementation,and post-go-live support, reducing system downtime.
  
  
 Workflow Automation: Creating code-based triggers or low-code automations to eliminate repetitive manualdata entry where ever needed
  
  
 Monitor and optimize system performance post-implementation, resolving reported issues.
  
  
IDEAL CANDIDATE
  
  
 Target Background: Experience in developing Software applications for core business/Industry processesand having functional Knowledge in functions like supply chain, order-to-cash, sales, inventory, WarehouseManagement, Accounting, Taxation, Purchase, order management etc.
  
  
 Experience - The Programmer should ideally have 5-12 years of continuous work experience in a singleorganization which can be an in-house IT department of a manufacturing company or local businessapplication / ERP companies working for Indian clients.
  
  
** Required Skills And Qualifications**
Platform Languages: Full stack combination. [ .Net (Microsoft) or C#, LINQ and JavaScript / Angular are the most common]
  
  
Database &Querying: Any Database or multiple data base for manipulating, querying, and optimizing large data sets.
  
  
**OUT OF SCOPE (WHO WILL NOT QUALIFY FOR THE ROLE)**
 Someone is interested to grow only one environment like Java
  
  
 Pure database, Front-end Developers
  
  
 Only API Integration Guys.
  
  
 Website Development experience
  
  
 Have limited interest in client-facing consulting and working closely with business and technology teams.
  
  
 Are not comfortable with travel required for client engagements.
  
  
 Are not inclined towards continuous learning, knowledge sharing and mentoring within the organisation andacross client engagements
  
  
 We are not looking for programmers who have worked for foreign clients in large IT organizations. Workexposure of Indian clients is a must

description:

Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.

overall IT experience

hands-on experience with

****Role Overview****

**Profisee MDM Technical Developer/Engineer**
with strong hands-on experience in
**Profisee Master Data Management**
, data integration, data quality,
**Azure Function Apps**
, and
**C#/.NET development**
.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for developing, configuring, integrating, and supporting enterprise MDM solutions using
**Profisee**
. The role requires a strong combination of
**Profisee MDM expertise, C#/.NET development, SQL, API development, and enterprise application integration**
.
  
  
The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, data stewards, application teams, Profisee Architect, data engineers, and enterprise architects to deliver high-quality master-data solutions.

* Support data stewardship processes and data governance requirements.

title: Senior Principal Engineer, Search Platform
description:
****Overview****
****Working at Atlassian****
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Your future team: Search Platform**
The Search Platform team is responsible for powering Rovo Search , knowledge discovery and search for humans and agents across all enterprise data. Our mission is to make all our customers' data across Atlassian and their external apps (i.e. third-party applications) searchable securely and reliably through an insanely fast, globally scalable, cost-efficient, enterprise grade search infrastructure. Powering search and discovery in the agentic era is a whole new challenge and this team is at the forefront for Atlassian.
  
  
****Responsibilities****
As a Senior Principal Engineer in Search Platform, you will own technical roadmap, execution and outcomes for the Search Data pillar. You will help envision, build and evolve a cutting-edge platform for integrating, processing, indexing and searching massive volumes of unstructured data across 100+ sources. Your deep expertise in large-scale data platforms, streaming and batch processing and distributed systems to solve some of our most complex problems including infrastructure, data and dev/agentic productivity challenges. Data is messy and hard and its the most critical, make or break input for Search and AI.
  
  
As a senior technical leader, you will be expected to lead other engineers to define our strategic technical direction, and to own outcomes from design to launch. Your role is pivotal in identifying and driving step-change initiatives, choosing the problems to solve vs not, in order to deliver a world-class end-to-end search experience, powered by rich data which is fresh, reliable across all apps.
  
  
****Responsibilities:****

* Collaborate with technical leads, partner teams and internal customers to define technical strategy and architecture for Search Data.
* Lead the evolution of our data platform and pipelines to meet the demands of both real-time search freshness and AI/agentic retrieval at enterprise scale.
* Make hard architectural trade-offs between freshness, correctness, cost, and operational simplicity - and own the outcomes.
* Drive the simplification and modernization of complex, legacy data processing systems. Identify and eliminate unnecessary complexity. Design systems that are understandable, testable, and operable.
* Establish design patterns and best practices for handling the inherent messiness of real-world data - schema evolution, partial failures, eventual consistency, connector variability, and data quality degradation.
* Own engineering and operational excellence for the health of our systems and processes. Proactively drive opportunities for continuous improvements and own key operational metrics.
* Transform developer productivity to ensure that we unleash the potential of our own team with agents. Champion a culture of high ownership, rigorous testing, safe rollouts, and data-driven engineering across Search Data teams.
* Help hire and mentor engineers to build an open, innovative and operationally responsible culture.

****Qualifications****
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
****Requirements:****

* Deep experience with distributed data frameworks (Kafka, Flink, Spark) - you have built, operated, and debugged systems processing billions of events per day. Ideally for Search and AI use cases where innovation relies on iterating over data. You understand their failure modes, not just their happy paths.
* Strong background in designing data architectures that handle messy, heterogeneous data at scale - including schema evolution, data quality, idempotency, backfill/replay, and partial failure recovery.
* Track record of simplifying complex systems. You have taken spaghetti systems and turned them into something engineers can reason about, test, and operate confidently.
* Demonstrated department-level technical leadership, influence across multiple teams, and ownership of top-level technical objectives tied to business outcomes. You identify ambiguity and bring clarity.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals. Fluency in at least one modern language (Java preferred). You write code, review code, and hold a high bar for engineering quality.
* Excellent communication skills. You can explain complex data architecture to engineers, product managers, and leadership with equal clarity.
* 12+ years of experience imagining, building and operating critical systems at scale.

****Benefits & Perks****
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**
****About Atlassian****
At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
  
  
To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
**go.atlassian.com/crh**
**.**
In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

title: GDS Cyber-CAOE-Senior-AI IT OT Network And Infrastructure Security
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI - IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Security – Senior**
**Role Summary**
We are looking for an AI - IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Security Senior professional with solution mindset and hands on security engineering expertise in network security / Infrastructure security concepts, risk and controls concepts, architecture design, transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a Senior professional who should have practical experience in network security engineering, detection engineering, and OT cyber risk reduction, with growing exposure to AI-assisted security operations, prompt engineering, AI-driven anomaly detection, and device behavior analytics.
  
  
This role is part of the Cyber Frontier & AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Understands design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Possess knowledge about deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE,DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Incident response and security improvement initiatives to enhance cyber resilience across hybrid infrastructure.
* Possess knowledge & experience on secure remote access, DMZ architecture, PLC security, and cloud network protection.
* Good understanding on AI-assisted IT/OT security architecture and operations, enabling predictive threat monitoring and automated response within industrial environments.
* Understands AI-driven anomaly detection models to identify deviations in OT network traffic, process behaviors, and industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, OPC).
* Build AI-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
* Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
* Implement AI-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network & Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4–8 years of experience across AI driven Network & Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.
* Experience with OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* Expertise in XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Strong capability in multi-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good soft skills i.e. verbal & written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Knowledge of Information security standards and compliances (ISO 27001, ISO 27017, NIST 800 53, NIST 800-207, CISA, CIS benchmark etc.)
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco & others)

**Why join us**
Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network & infra structure security portfolio in an AI-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network & infrastructure security practice as technology-enabled, consulting-led, and globally delivered.
  
  
**Typical work environment**

* Global, cross-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: BCM-BankingDomain-SeniorManager-GDSF02
description:

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centres. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support for EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today, we stand at 80,000+ professionals across ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy and Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality and value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, highly skilled and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure Services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings together the appropriate environment, technologies and skilled professionals to facilitate rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an accomplished
**Banking Solution Architect at the Senior Manager level**
to lead the architecture, design and implementation of enterprise banking solutions.
  
  
The role requires deep expertise in
**Temenos platforms, including T24, Transact and WealthSuite; Finacle platforms, including Core Banking, DEH, CDH and Alerts; or new-generation banking platforms such as Backbase, Mambu and Thought Machine.**
The Senior Manager will provide architecture leadership across complex core banking modernisation, migration and digital transformation programmes. The role requires strong banking domain knowledge, extensive technical and solution architecture expertise, and the ability to engage senior stakeholders across business, technology and operations functions.
  
  
The successful candidate will define scalable solution architectures, provide strategic technology direction, lead client workshops and solution walkthroughs, govern delivery outcomes, and develop architecture capabilities across teams. This is primarily an architecture, consulting and leadership position and does not involve hands-on coding responsibilities. [RE: Calib...or Manager | Outlook]
  
  
**Role:**
Banking Solution Architect – Senior Manager
  
  
**Experience**
: 20+ years
  
  
**Domain:**
Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Digital Banking, Private Banking, Wealth Management, Payments and Core Banking Transformation
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**- Architecture Leadership
- Lead the definition, validation and governance of enterprise solution architectures for core banking transformation, modernisation and migration programmes.
- Develop target-state architecture, transition architecture, solution blueprints and implementation roadmaps aligned with client business objectives.
- Provide architectural leadership for digital-first banking journeys across retail, corporate, private banking and wealth management.
- Evaluate business and technology requirements and translate them into scalable, secure and resilient banking solutions.
- Ensure solution designs align with enterprise architecture principles, technology standards, regulatory expectations and established governance frameworks.
- Lead architecture reviews and provide recommendations on platform selection, integration patterns, deployment models and implementation approaches.
- Own key architecture decisions and maintain decision logs, design principles, standards and reusable architecture assets.
- Banking Platform Leadership
- Provide subject-matter expertise across one or more of the following platform groups:

* Temenos: T24, Transact, TAP, TDS, TCIB, Infinity, WealthSuite and Journey Manager.
* Finacle: Core Banking, DEH, CDH, Alerts, Origination, FEBA, Internet Banking and Mobile Banking.
* New-Generation Banking Platforms: Backbase, Mambu and Thought Machine.

- Define platform architecture covering product configuration, customisation, integration, data migration, security and operational readiness.
- Guide core banking implementation, upgrade, migration and modernisation programmes.
- Assess platform capabilities against business requirements and recommend appropriate configuration, extension or integration approaches.
- Provide architectural oversight for Finacle customisation across relevant versions, including scripting, hooks and deployment frameworks.
- Support the development of platform roadmaps that enable modularity, interoperability, cloud adoption and improved customer experience.
- Integration and API Architecture
- Design integration architectures using microservices, event-driven architecture, APIs, middleware and messaging platforms.
- Define API orchestration strategies using technologies and standards such as Kafka, Apigee, YAML, REST and SOAP.
- Establish integration patterns for connecting core banking platforms with digital channels, payments, customer information systems, data platforms, risk systems and third-party services.
- Define principles for service decomposition, event management, exception handling, resiliency, observability and interface security.
- Guide teams in selecting appropriate synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns.
- Ensure APIs and integration components comply with enterprise security, performance, scalability and governance requirements.
- Cloud, DevOps and Engineering Governance
- Define cloud-enabled and container-based architecture using platforms and technologies such as AWS, Docker, Kubernetes and OpenShift.
- Provide guidance on CI/CD pipelines, environment strategies, release governance and deployment automation.
- Ensure architecture supports availability, performance, scalability, maintainability, recoverability and operational resilience.
- Work with engineering, infrastructure, security and operations teams to establish appropriate non-functional requirements.
- Provide architectural oversight across the software development lifecycle while maintaining a strategic, non-coding leadership focus.
- Drive the adoption of engineering standards, reusable components and architecture guardrails across delivery teams.
- Client and Stakeholder Engagement
- Engage with senior client stakeholders across business, operations, architecture, engineering, infrastructure, security and programme leadership.
- Conduct discovery sessions, architecture workshops, requirement-gathering discussions and solution walkthroughs.
- Translate complex technology concepts into clear business outcomes, options and recommendations.
- Present architecture decisions, risks, dependencies, trade-offs and implementation considerations to senior governance forums.
- Build trusted relationships with client executives, technology leaders, product vendors and ecosystem partners.
- Support conflict resolution and consensus building across stakeholders with differing business and technology priorities.
- Programme Delivery and Governance
- Provide architecture leadership throughout discovery, design, build, testing, migration, implementation and post-production stabilisation.
- Partner with programme and delivery leadership to establish realistic roadmaps, milestones, dependencies and resource requirements.
- Identify architecture-related risks and issues and drive timely mitigation and resolution.
- Govern adherence to approved architecture, design principles, non-functional requirements and technology standards.
- Review project deliverables, solution designs, interface specifications and implementation approaches.
- Support design assurance, implementation readiness and production-go-live governance.
- Ensure effective coordination between platform teams, engineering teams, testing teams, vendors and client stakeholders.
- Data, Security and Regulatory Alignment
- Define architecture considerations for banking data, including data integration, migration, lineage, quality, reconciliation and reporting.
- Ensure solutions support appropriate authentication, authorisation, encryption, tokenisation and multi-factor authentication controls.
- Collaborate with risk, compliance, cybersecurity and financial crime teams to align solutions with applicable banking control requirements.
- Incorporate AML, fraud-monitoring and transaction-monitoring integration considerations into solution designs where relevant.
- Ensure security, privacy and regulatory requirements are considered throughout the architecture and delivery lifecycle.
- Guide teams in addressing technical debt, security vulnerabilities and architecture deviations.
- People Leadership and Team Management

* Lead and mentor solution architects, technical architects, consultants and engineering leads.
* Allocate resources, assign responsibilities and ensure that teams have the necessary tools, guidance and support to succeed.
* Establish clear objectives and provide timely coaching, feedback and professional development support.
* Build architecture capability through structured mentoring, knowledge-sharing sessions, training and reusable assets.
* Support talent identification, hiring, onboarding, performance management and succession planning.
* Promote collaboration, accountability, inclusion and continuous learning across geographically distributed teams.
* Optimise team structures and delivery processes to achieve programme and organisational objectives.
* Practice Development and Business Growth

+ Contribute to the growth of EY’s Banking and Capital Markets technology consulting capabilities.
+ Support proposals, client presentations, solution demonstrations, estimations and responses to requests for proposals.
+ Develop architecture offerings, thought leadership, reference architectures, reusable frameworks and accelerators.
+ Identify opportunities to extend client engagements and develop new banking transformation propositions.
+ Collaborate with account leadership, alliance partners and platform vendors to shape market opportunities.
+ Contribute to internal communities of practice and strengthen organisational capabilities across banking platforms and architecture.
+ Represent the practice in client discussions, industry forums and internal knowledge-sharing sessions, as appropriate.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**The successful candidate should demonstrate:**

* Strong leadership and executive-level stakeholder management capabilities.
* Deep understanding of retail, corporate, digital, private and transaction banking domains.
* Extensive experience in solution architecture for large-scale banking transformation programmes.

**Preferred Technology Experience**

**Security**

* TOGAF or an equivalent enterprise architecture certification.
* Certifications or formal training in Temenos, Finacle, Backbase, Mambu or Thought Machine.

We are looking for a recognised banking architecture leader who can combine deep domain knowledge, platform expertise, technology strategy and consulting leadership to deliver measurable client outcomes.

title: Kubernetes Controller Developer (Golang)
description:
**Job Category:**
Infrastructure Engineering
  
  
**Job Type:**
Full Time
  
  
**Job Location:**
India US (EST/CST)
  
  
**Reports To:**
Director of Cloud Infrastructure
  
  
**Role Overview**
Join our Core Kubernetes Operator Development team, where we’re pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes innovation. As a
**Kubernetes Controller Developer (Golang)**
, you will play a crucial role in building
**“01”**
, our cloud-agnostic Platform as a Service (PaaS), driven by full-fledged Kubernetes operators and agents.
  
  
This position requires a strong background in Kubernetes internals and Golang programming, particularly in developing and managing Kubernetes controllers. If you’re a proactive problem solver with experience in building cloud-native infrastructure, this is your opportunity to contribute to a transformative platform.
  
  
We highly encourage candidates with a solid programming foundation and a hunger to explore the cloud-native world to apply. Comprehensive onboarding and professional development support will be provided.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities (Not Limited To)**

* Collaborate in Agile teams, taking ownership of development stories with minimal supervision.
* Partner with internal teams and clients to accurately capture technical requirements.
* Design, build, deploy, and maintain Kubernetes controllers and operators using Golang.
* Identify gaps in current systems and propose or implement technical improvements.
* Apply best practices across the full software development lifecycle.
* Create and execute unit, regression, and E2E tests for operator reliability.
* Work in Linux environments and troubleshoot issues in containerized applications.
* Contribute to CI/CD workflows for seamless testing and deployment.

* Kubernetes Controller Development: Proven expertise in building and maintaining controllers and operators.
* Proficiency in Golang: 2+ years writing idiomatic, well-tested Go code for Kubernetes projects.
* Deep understanding of Kubernetes APIs and libraries including client-go, CRDs, and API extensions.

+ Kubebuilder – For scaffolding controllers and CRDs
+ Operator SDK – For building Operators with OLM support
+ controller-runtime – For abstracting Kubernetes client logic

* Strong testing skills, including unit, load, and E2E tests for operators.
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes).
* Comfortable working in Linux with debugging tools and CLI.
* 2+ years experience working with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Tekton, or similar.

**Preferred Skills (Nice To Have)**

The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills - A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
  
  
Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation, Synchrony's Engineering Team is the place to be
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
We are seeking a motivated AVP, Sr Product Engineer, APEX to help design, build, and evolve modern low-code web applications on the Oracle Application Express platform. You will work alongside senior architects and cross-functional agile teams to deliver scalable, secure, and user-friendly solutions that integrate seamlessly with enterprise systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop Oracle APEX applications, including pages, components, dynamic actions, and reports.
* Write efficient PL/SQL, SQL, and database objects (tables, views, packages, triggers) to support application logic and performance.
* Implement custom UI enhancements using JavaScript, jQuery, HTML5, and CSS3 to extend APEX out-of-the-box capabilities.
* Integrate APEX applications with external systems through REST and SOAP web services (both consuming and exposing endpoints via ORDS).
* Collaborate with senior architects on solution design, data modeling, and technical decisions.
* Participate actively in agile/Scrum ceremonies — sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing APEX applications for performance, security, and maintainability.
* Apply best practices for application security (authentication, authorization, session state protection, OWASP guidelines).
* Document technical designs, integration specifications, and deployment procedures.
* Support code reviews, testing, and CI/CD-driven deployments across environments

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* 6+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle APEX (version 20.x or higher must).
* 4+ years of experience in Oracle Database, PL/SQL, and SQL (query tuning, analytical functions, packages).
* 4+ years of JavaScript (ES6+) and the APEX JavaScript API.
* Proficiency with CSS3 and responsive design principles; familiarity with Universal Theme customization.
* Mandatory: 4+ years of integrating APEX applications with RESTful and/or SOAP web services, including handling JSON/XML payloads, authentication (OAuth2, Basic, API keys), and error handling.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Familiarity with Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS) for publishing APIs.
* Working experience in agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills — able to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.

**Eligibility Criteria:**
Minimum 6+Years of experience mentioned in “ Required Skill/Knowledge” with a Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent. In Lieu of degree , minimum of 8 years of experience required.
  
  
**Work Timings: 2 PM – 11 PM IST**
This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs)
  
  
We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.
  
  
Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events

**Description:**

Indorama Ventures is a global sustainable chemical company operating across multiple verticals such as Combined PET, Fibers, and Integrated Oxides & Derivatives. The Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Kolkata, India supports worldwide operations through centralized IT, Finance and business process services.
  
  
**Job Location - Kolkata, Hyderabad**
**Position Overview**
The
**o9 Solutions Integration (INT3.0) & Data Lead**
is responsible for
**owning, governing, and continuously improving the technical integration landscape**
supporting the
**o9 Solutions IBP platform**
. The role provides
**hands-on Integration 3.0 (INT3.0) expertise**
from day one, translating integration requirements into reliable, supportable, and scalable data flows across o9 and upstream or downstream enterprise systems.
  
  
This position acts as the technical integration authority within the IBP CoE. It combines architecture, delivery, operations, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder leadership. This person will work closely with functional leads, the Solution Architect, data teams, infrastructure and security teams, implementation partners, and business stakeholders to ensure that integrations are production-ready and sustainably transitioned into support.
  
  
**Role Purpose and Outcomes**

* Own the o9 INT3.0 integration workstream and provide practical, recent implementation expertise with minimal dependency on project-team knowledge transfer.
* Establish stable, traceable, and supportable inbound and outbound interfaces for IBP planning processes.
* Improve operational resilience through runbooks, batch monitoring, error-log knowledge, root-cause analysis, and repeatable recovery procedures.
* Enable faster and safer releases by applying technical design standards, quality controls, and disciplined deployment practices.
* Support targeted Python-based plug-ins, procedures, and automation under the guidance of functional and solution leads.

**What You'll Do**
**Key Responsibilities**
**o9 Integration 3.0 Technical Ownership**

* Act as the primary technical owner for o9 Integration 3.0 across design, build, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Design and maintain integration patterns for master, transactional, planning, and analytical data exchanged between o9 and enterprise systems.
* Assess integration requirements, define technical options, document decisions, and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and security standards.
* Provide technical guidance to internal teams, vendors, and implementation partners, and review integration deliverables for quality and maintainability.

**Integration Engineering and Data Flows**

* Develop, configure, enhance, and troubleshoot data ingestion and extraction pipelines, transformations, orchestration, schedules, and dependencies.
* Work with ERP, data-platform, middleware, cloud, and data-provider teams to define interface contracts, mappings, validation rules, cadence, and ownership.
* Ensure integrations correctly handle full and delta loads, sequencing, reconciliation, restorability, exceptions, and downstream dependencies.
* Perform technical analysis of complex data issues and distinguish source-data, transformation, configuration, platform, and infrastructure causes.

**Batch Operations, Monitoring and Support**

* Own batch-flow visibility, operational monitoring, issue triage, and technical coordination for failed or delayed integrations.
* Create and maintain batch runbooks, support procedures, error-log libraries, escalation paths, and recovery instructions that are specific to the implemented landscape.
* Lead root-cause analysis for recurring incidents and convert findings into preventive controls, automation, or design improvements.
* Support production releases, continuous improvement through Change Requests, and transition to steady-state operations, including knowledge transfer to data and support teams.

**Technical Development and Automation**

* Use Python where appropriate to develop plug-ins, procedures, utilities, validations, and automation that complement o9 configuration and integration capabilities.
* Apply sound software-engineering practices including version control, modular design, code review, logging, exception handling, testing, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with functional experts to translate planning requirements into safe and maintainable technical extensions without compromising platform standards.

**Quality, Security and Release Governance**

* Define and apply technical quality gates for integration design, code, configuration, testing evidence, deployment readiness, and documentation completeness.
* Prepare unit, system-integration, regression, performance, and reconciliation test scenarios in collaboration with QA and functional teams.
* Ensure secure handling of credentials, access, data transfers, service accounts, certificates, and environment-specific configuration in line with approved policies.
* Identify technical debt, performance risks, and single points of failure, and maintain a prioritized improvement roadmap.

**Agile Delivery and Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Author and refine technical user stories, tasks, acceptance criteria, estimates, dependencies, and implementation plans.
* Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and defect-triage forums.
* Communicate technical risks, decisions, and recovery options clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Mentor less-experienced technical resources and strengthen internal integration capability through structured knowledge sharing.

**What We're Looking For**
**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 1 year of hands-on o9 INT3.0 integration experience.
* Recent delivery experience on o9 implementation projects, with demonstrated ownership of Integration 3.0 work and implementation outcomes.
* Strong practical knowledge of o9 INT3.0 concepts, tools, deployment patterns, batch processing, operational monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience integrating with SAP or other ERP systems, data platforms, middleware, file-transfer services, and cloud environments.
* Strong SQL and data-engineering fundamentals, including data modeling, mapping, transformation, reconciliation, dependency management, and performance analysis.
* Working Python programming experience for plug-ins, procedures, validation utilities, or automation.
* Experience with APIs, structured files, secure file transfer, authentication methods, scheduling or orchestration, and environment promotion practices.
* Experience producing technical integration designs, data-flow diagrams, interface specifications, deployment plans, runbooks, and support documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to work in agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Certifications**

* o9 Integration 3.0 (INT3.0) certification is required; equivalent demonstrable expertise must be supported by recent project evidence.
* Additional o9 technical, platform, configuration, performance, or analytics certifications are valued.
* Relevant cloud, data engineering, integration, security, agile, or project-management certifications are advantageous.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in global IBP or supply-chain planning programs spanning Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OP/IBP, and KPI or analytics solutions.
* Experience operating in a Center of Excellence model and transitioning implementation knowledge into internal support ownership.
* Exposure to customer-managed cloud or Azure-based deployments, enterprise identity integration, and secure data-transfer patterns.
* Experience improving batch performance, observability, error handling, and resilience in business-critical planning landscapes.
* Ability to contribute across integration architecture and hands-on delivery while maintaining a clear separation between standard platform configuration and custom development.

**Behavioural And Leadership Skills**

* Technical ownership: takes accountability for outcomes, follows issues through resolution, and makes risks visible early.
* Analytical problem solving: structures ambiguous technical problems, tests hypotheses, and produces evidence-based conclusions.
* Communication: explains complex integration behavior to both engineering teams and business stakeholders in clear language.
* Collaboration: works effectively across functional consultants, architects, data teams, infrastructure, security, vendors, and business users.
* Quality mindset: values documentation, repeatability, traceability, and sustainable support over short-term fixes.
* Coaching: strengthens team capability through reviews, standards, reusable examples, and hands-on knowledge transfer.

**Success Measures**

* Reliable execution of scheduled integrations with clear monitoring, ownership, and recovery procedures.
* Reduced recurrence and resolution time of integration incidents through root-cause elimination and better operational knowledge.
* Complete, current, and usable technical documentation for interfaces, batches, error handling, deployments, and support.
* Consistent compliance with design, security, testing, release, and support-readiness standards.
* Effective transfer of integration knowledge from project resources into the IBP CoE and support organization.
* Timely delivery of approved enhancements and automation with measurable improvement in platform operability and team productivity.

**Candidate Evidence Expected**
Candidates should be prepared to provide concrete examples from recent o9 engagements, including:
  
  

* Their exact role, duration, and ownership in each o9 project.
* INT3.0 interfaces designed or delivered, source and target systems, data volumes or cadence, and production responsibilities.
* Examples of complex incidents diagnosed and permanently resolved.
* Examples of integration design documents, runbooks, monitoring approaches, or error-management practices they created.
* Python solutions personally developed and the business or operational problem addressed.
* Current o9 certifications and evidence of relevant o9 training completion.

title: AI Platform Architect (Teradyne, India)
description:
**Job Title:**
AI Platform Architect
  
  
**Reports to:**
Enterprise AI Architect
  
  
**Our Purpose**
TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are challenged to innovate and learn something new every day.
  
  
We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.
  
  
****What You Will Do****
As an AI Platform Architect I at Teradyne, you will help shape how AI is architected, integrated, and governed across the enterprise, spanning AI agent and MCP infrastructure, platform and connector integration, AI governance and risk processes, and enterprise AI literacy. Reporting to the Enterprise AI Architect, you will translate our enterprise AI strategy into concrete architecture patterns, deployment standards, and governance practices, primarily across Azure Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio and Copilot Cowork, Snowflake Cortex AI, and Claude.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical, architecture-focused role. You will define reusable patterns for deploying AI agents, standardize MCP server design and CI/CD pipelines, AI platform configuration, and set up authentication and authorization middleware for AI agents and services. You will also contribute to the enterprise AI gateway and connector strategy, support AI governance and risk-review processes, and help drive enterprise AI literacy, ensuring AI initiatives scale securely, consistently, and responsibly.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
AI Platform & Environment Enablement
  
  

* Manage platform settings, integrations, and resource allocations to ensure optimal performance and cost-efficiency for development teams
* Set up and maintain authentication/authorization middleware for AI agents and services, partnering with the team that owns enterprise identity/access management
* Standardize Model Context Protocol (MCP) server design, deployment templates, and infrastructure-as-code patterns
* Design and own CI/CD pipelines for AI agent, MCP, and/or AI model deployments (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps)

****Business Outcome:****
Provide well-configured, secure, and efficient AI platform environments that enable teams to build and deploy AI solutions reliably.
  
  
**AI Solution Development**

* Define architecture patterns and standards for deploying AI agents across the enterprise, primarily on Azure Foundry, Microsoft Copilot / Copilot Studio / Copilot Cowork, Snowflake Cortex AI, and Claude
* Establish and document reusable playbooks and modular workflows for agentic AI development, ensuring rapid adoption and consistency across teams leveraging both no-code and programmatic development environments
* Architect Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agent infrastructure on cloud AI development platforms
* Contribute to the design and maintenance of the enterprise AI gateway, including the MCP registry, LLM traffic routing, observability, rate limiting, data redaction, and access control
* Contribute to the enterprise connector/integration strategy connecting AI tools to core business systems
* Lead architecture reviews for AI agent and enterprise copilot tooling deployments

****Business Outcome:****
Deliver well-architected, reusable AI solutions that accelerate adoption and demonstrate the value of enterprise AI investment.
  
  
**AI Governance, Security, and Observability**

* Contribute to AI governance and risk-review processes, including evaluating new LLMs before adoption and reviewing AI tool and connector requests
* Partner with security, legal, and compliance teams to help shape AI risk frameworks, policy, and data governance standards
* Contribute to enterprise AI literacy/training tracking and reporting

****Business Outcome:****
Strengthen AI governance and risk posture while building enterprise-wide AI literacy and capability.
  
  
****Required Qualifications****
  
  

* Experience: 2–5 years of experience in AI/ML or platform engineering, with hands-on experience deploying AI systems in an enterprise environment
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field
* Technical Skills:

+ Required hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure AI Foundry
+ Additional experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, Snowflake Cortex AI, and Claude is ideal
+ Proficiency in Python and SQL
+ Hands-on experience building and deploying AI Agents and MCP Servers
+ Experience designing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps
+ Experience with Infrastructure as Code
+ Some hands-on experience setting up authentication/authorization
+ Experience building custom RAG pipelines
+ Familiarity with AI governance/risk frameworks
+ Understanding of API/connector integration patterns for enterprise systems

* Soft Skills:

+ Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across technical and business teams
+ Analytical mindset with a focus on delivering measurable business outcomes
+ Comfortable contributing to governance and security review processes

**Why Join Teradyne?**
At Teradyne, we are committed to innovation, operational excellence, and empowering our teams to deliver cutting-edge AI solutions that drive business value. As an AI Platform Architect I, you will have the opportunity to work on transformative projects, collaborate with talented professionals, and shape the future of AI at Teradyne. Join us and be part of a team that is redefining what's possible with AI.

* Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
* Good understanding of cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, load balancing, observability, logging, and access controls.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, deployment failures, distributed systems, and performance bottlenecks.

title: Mid & Senior Informatica MDM & IDQ Developer – MDM Hub & ActiveVOS
description:
Mid & Senior Informatica MDM & IDQ Developer – MDM Hub & ActiveVOS

Experience- 5–15 Years

Employment Type- Full-Time

Work Location- Remote

Notice Period- Immediate

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Informatica MDM & IDQ Developer with strong hands-on expertise in Informatica Multidomain MDM, MDM Hub Console, Informatica Data Quality (IDQ/CDQ), and ActiveVOS.

The ideal candidate should be a strong technical resource who can work directly within the MDM Hub Console, understand business requirements, configure and develop MDM solutions, build and customize match/merge and survivorship logic, and develop ActiveVOS workflows for data stewardship and approval processes.

This is a hands-on development and configuration role requiring deep knowledge of Informatica MDM architecture, MDM Hub configuration, data quality, integration, and workflow development.

Key Responsibilities

Informatica MDM Development & Configuration

* Work extensively with the Informatica MDM Hub Console for configuration, development, testing, and deployment.
* Configure and develop Base Objects, Landing Tables, Staging Tables, Mappings, Packages, Queries, Tokens, Match Rules, Merge Rules, and Trust/Survivorship Rules.
* Design and implement MDM solutions based on business and data governance requirements.
* Configure match and merge strategies, including deterministic and probabilistic matching.
* Configure trust, validation, survivorship, and consolidation rules.
* Develop and maintain Business Entity Services (BES) and associated MDM services.
* Configure and maintain Hub Jobs, batch processes, load jobs, tokenization, and cleanse processes.
* Troubleshoot data processing, matching, merging, and consolidation issues within the MDM Hub.
* Perform MDM configuration changes, enhancements, testing, and production deployments.

ActiveVOS Workflow Development

* Design, develop, configure, and maintain ActiveVOS workflows integrated with Informatica MDM.
* Develop workflows for data stewardship, approvals, exception handling, and business processes.
* Configure ActiveVOS tasks, business processes, rules, notifications, and assignments.
* Integrate ActiveVOS workflows with MDM Hub and Business Entity Services.
* Troubleshoot workflow failures, stuck tasks, integration issues, and process bottlenecks.
* Customize workflows based on changing business and data governance requirements.

Informatica Data Quality (IDQ/CDQ)

* Develop and maintain data quality mappings, transformations, cleansing, standardization, and validation rules.
* Work with profiling, scorecards, reference data, and reusable data quality components.
* Configure and maintain AddressDoctor and address cleansing/standardization processes.
* Identify data quality issues and implement appropriate remediation and cleansing strategies.
* Integrate IDQ capabilities with MDM processes to improve data accuracy and consistency.

Integration & API Development

* Develop and support integrations between Informatica MDM and upstream/downstream applications.
* Work with REST/SOAP APIs, Business Entity Services, web services, and application integrations.
* Configure and troubleshoot MDM data publishing and integration processes.
* Work with ETL/data integration processes for loading and synchronizing master data.
* Troubleshoot integration failures and performance issues across MDM and connected systems.

Production Support & Performance

* Monitor MDM processes, workflows, integrations, and scheduled jobs.
* Analyze and resolve production issues related to MDM Hub, IDQ, and ActiveVOS.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.
* Optimize match rules, mappings, queries, batch processes, and workflows for better performance.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, database, application, and vendor teams when required.
* Support deployment, release management, upgrades, patches, and migration activities.

Required Skills & Experience

* 5–10 years of overall IT/data management experience, with significant hands-on experience in Informatica MDM.
* Strong hands-on development and configuration experience with Informatica Multidomain MDM / Informatica MDM Hub.
* Must have extensive experience working directly with the MDM Hub Console.
* Strong understanding of MDM configuration, development, match/merge, survivorship, trust, validation, and consolidation.
* Strong hands-on experience with ActiveVOS workflow development and administration.
* Experience developing and maintaining MDM Business Entity Services (BES).
* Strong experience with Informatica Data Quality (IDQ/CDQ).
* Good understanding of Informatica MDM architecture and data model.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or Snowflake.
* Experience with REST/SOAP APIs and web-service integrations.
* Good understanding of ETL/data integration concepts.
* Experience with Linux/Unix environments and shell scripting.
* Ability to troubleshoot application, database, integration, and MDM-related issues independently.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be:

* A hands-on Informatica MDM developer/configurator, not purely an administrator.
* Comfortable navigating the MDM Hub Console and independently configuring and developing MDM components.
* Strong in ActiveVOS workflow development and MDM workflow integration.
* Able to understand complex master-data requirements and convert them into technical MDM solutions.
* Strong in troubleshooting, debugging, performance tuning, and production support.
* Capable of working independently with business, data governance, integration, and technical teams.

Core Technical Skills

Primary:

Informatica MDM Hub | MDM Hub Console | ActiveVOS | Informatica IDQ/CDQ | Match & Merge | Survivorship | Trust Rules | Business Entity Services | Data Stewardship Workflows

You will lead the technical vision, architecture and delivery for planetary-scale data ingestion and indexing platforms while ensuring Search meets strict enterprise commitments across multi-cloud (GCP/AWS), isolated cloud, compliance, and encryption.
  
  
****Responsibilities****

* Lead Enterprise Trust & Compliance: Own technical strategy and delivery for enterprise requirements - multi-cloud (GCP/AWS), Isolated Cloud, FedRAMP, BYOK encryption, and data residency - making Search a platform enterprises can trust. Proactively simplifying architecture and removing
* Shape the Indexing Platform for AI-era Workloads: Evolve high-throughput, low-latency distributed indexing pipelines to meet the retrieval demands of agentic and AI use cases - freshness, context relevance, and scale across billions of events.
* Connect Across Teams and Systems: Work fluidly across ML, Data, Cloud Infrastructure, and product teams - aligning technical direction, unblocking dependencies, and building shared platform capabilities that multiply the impact of teams beyond your own. Help improve support for building and operating systems that deliver true Enterprise Trust through Atlassian-wide platforms, while actively simplifying the architecture and eliminating accumulated complexity.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
****Requirements****

* Distributed Systems Depth: Proven experience designing and operating large-scale distributed data pipelines, search/indexing systems, or streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Flink, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, object-store-backed indexing, vector search).
* Cross-functional Influence: Experience driving alignment and delivery across multiple teams and systems - someone who is just as effective collaborating and influencing as they are executing independently.
* Speed with Judgment: A track record of making fast, pragmatic trade-offs that deliver near-term value without accumulating long-term technical debt.

title: Head of Engineering, Commerce Platform
description:
**Overview**
As the
**Head of Engineering for the Core Commerce Platform**
, you will be the primary architect and leader of Atlassian’s next-generation monetization engine. This is a high-stakes leadership role at the intersection of engineering excellence, financial integrity, and business transformation. You will lead a department of
**50–70 engineers**
in India, tasked with evolving our legacy billing systems into a world-class, enterprise-scale platform that powers Atlassian’s multi-billion dollar revenue stream.
  
  
Your mission is to build a
**unified, multi-modal billing platform**
that seamlessly integrates traditional seat-based models with modern, value-based consumption models. This platform is the "monetization backbone" that converts every customer interaction—from a Jira seat to an AI-powered Rovo credit—into accurate, transparent, and compliant revenue.
  
  
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Platform Modernization: Transition the Commerce Cloud Platform (CCP) from a seat-centric system to a flexible, meter-agnostic engine capable of handling high-concurrency usage events and complex financial settlements.
* Enterprise Readiness: Deliver "hardened" commerce capabilities for our largest customers, including aggregate quoting, threshold-based invoicing, and advanced credit management.
* Financial Integrity & Compliance: Ensure 100% accuracy in revenue recognition (MRR/ARR) and downstream finance integrations. You will own the systems that interface with Stripe and internal financial reporting tools.
* AI-Native Transformation: Drive the adoption of AI within the platform itself—leveraging AI for automated testing of complex commerce scenarios, anomaly detection in billing, and optimizing the "Usage Event → Invoice" pipeline.
* Operational Excellence: Manage Tier 1 external-facing services where downtime directly impacts Atlassian’s ability to transact. You will instill a culture of "zero-error" engineering and high-availability architecture.
* Executive Influencing: As a key leader in Commerce organization, you will represent the platform's roadmap to C-level stakeholders, ensuring engineering capacity aligns with Atlassian’s strategic monetization goals.

**Qualifications**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  

* Global Scale Leadership: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5+ years in a senior leadership role at a global, hyper-scale technology organization. You have successfully led large, multi-layered engineering departments (50+ people) through managers and senior technical leaders.
* Monetization & Billing Expertise: Deep domain expertise in building and scaling Enterprise-grade Billing, Payments, or Commerce Platforms. You have a proven track record of architecting systems that support diverse pricing models, including Seat-based, Usage/Consumption-based, Ramp, and Flex models.
* High-Stakes Execution: Experience managing Tier 1, business-critical services where system reliability and financial accuracy are paramount. You understand the rigor required to manage platforms that power billions in annual revenue with "zero-error" tolerance.
* Strategic Platform Transformation: Demonstrated success in leading major organizational and technical shifts, such as transitioning a company’s core business model or modernizing legacy monetization infrastructure into a flexible, multi-modal engine.
* Education: BS/MS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

**Benefits & Perks**
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly proficient Azure Cloud Container & Platform Engineer (5–8 years of experience) to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for architecting, deploying, and maintaining secure, scalable, and production-grade containerized platforms on Azure. You will focus on the end-to-end lifecycle of containerized workloads, spanning from development to deployment across Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Container Apps, and Azure App Service (Container Runtime), all underpinned by robust Azure DevOps CI/CD strategies.
  
  
Requirements:
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Automation: Design, build, and maintain Azure Kubernetes, Container, Container Instances, Azure Web App Container Runtime using Bicep, ARM, Terraforom Automate the provisioning of key components including Key Vault (secrets/certificates), User Assigned Managed Identities (UAMI), Storage Accounts, and comprehensive monitoring workspaces.
  
  
Kubernetes Resource Management (AKS): Architect, deploy, and manage Kubernetes resources following GitOps best practices. This includes managing Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, and implementing Horizontal Pod Autoscalers (HPA) and Pod Disruption Budgets (PDB) to ensure workload reliability.
  
  
Container Runtime & App Service Management: Configure and optimize the execution environment for containerized web applications within Azure App Service and Azure Container Apps, ensuring seamless integration with CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Image Management & Registry (ACR): Oversee Azure Container Registry (ACR) lifecycles, including geo-replication, image lifecycle policies, and secure image scanning.
  
  
Networking & Traffic Management: Deploy and manage Ingress controllers (NGINX), configure private endpoints, and implement robust traffic routing and load balancing strategies for both AKS and App Service containers.
  
  
Security, Governance & Compliance: Enforce enterprise security standards using Azure RBAC, Workload Identities, and network segmentation (NSGs/Firewalls). Manage secret rotation via Key Vault + CSI driver integration.
  
  
Observability: Configure full-stack monitoring using Azure Monitor for Containers, Application Insights, and Prometheus/Grafana to build real-time dashboards for infrastructure and application health.
  
  
AKS Upgrades: Handling AKS Cluster and Node upgrades seamlessly without impact to business operations.
  
  
Platform Operations: Support containerized application lifecycles using Kubernetes architect and manage robust CI/CD pipelines and drive proactive monitoring and rapid troubleshooting of cluster-wide issues.
  
  
Security & Regulatory Compliance: Enforce enterprise-grade security via RBAC, complex network policies, and encryption ensure strict adherence to industry-specific compliance frameworks such as RBI and PCI DSS.
  
  
Strategic Leadership: Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Azure Kubernetes, Container mentoring engineering teams and championing the adoption of GitOps practices.
  
  
**Requirements & Qualifications**
Experience: 5–8 years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure, with deep expertise in Azure Kubernetes and container orchestration.
  
  
Technical Expertise:
  
  

* Containers: Expert knowledge of Docker, image optimization, and container runtime environments (AKS, Azure Container Apps, App Service).
* Orchestration: Deep understanding of Kubernetes resources, Helm, and GitOps workflows.
* IaC: Advanced proficiency in Bicep, ARM template, Terraform
* Cloud Foundation: Strong knowledge of Azure Networking (VNets/NSGs), Storage, and Identity (UAMI/Workload Identity).
* DevOps: Proven experience with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, service connections, and artifact repositories.

Certification Required:
  
  

* Cloud: Microsoft Certified: AZ-305, AZ-400
* Platform: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD).

Professional Attributes: Excellent troubleshooting skills across Linux, Kubernetes, and Azure strong commitment to standardization, security-first design, and audit compliance.
  
  
Professional Experience/Attribute
  
  
Strong familiarity with Azure cloud services with deep and comprehensive knowledge of DNS, Networking.
  
  
Exceptional analytical skills and the ability to derive actionable insights from complex data.
  
  
Effective communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of working with cross-functional teams.
  
  
Adept at defining and tracking KPIs for performance improvement.
  
  
Prior experience in monitoring and analyzing cloud cost trends.
  
  
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  
  
Ability to create and maintain documentation for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
Highly self-motivated individuals with the ability to identify areas of focus and tackle new challenges.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to deliver clear and measurable results, aligned with planned goals.
  
  
Strong analytical skills for extracting insights and actionable items from available data.
  
  
Adaptability to work in a dynamic international environment.
  
  
Exceptional teamwork and communication skills.
  
  
Promotes open sharing of views and encourages collaboration.
  
  
Strong oral, written, and presentation abilities in English.
  
  
Commitment to standardization and simplification in all work aspects.

Summary:
  
  
As an OTM Consultant, you will lead and deliver Oracle Transportation Management (OTM) solutions for global clients. This role demands strong functional and technical expertise in OTM, experience in end-to-end implementations, and the ability to work independently or as part of a team. You will collaborate with stakeholders to design optimized solutions, configure OTM modules, and ensure successful project delivery.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Lead or participate in full lifecycle OTM implementation projects, including requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment.
* Configure OTM modules such as Order Management, Shipment Management, Execution & Visibility, Finance, and FTI.
* Develop and maintain automation agents, workflows, and custom events. Perform functional and technical analysis, troubleshoot issues, and optimize system performance.
* Support OTM Cloud implementations and on-premise to cloud migration activities.
* Manage integrations with ERP/WMS systems and external partners.
* Prepare functional documentation, process flows, and configuration guides.
* Act as a solution lead, guiding junior consultants and ensuring adherence to best practices. Collaborate in Agile/DevOps environments, contributing to CI/CD pipelines and version control processes.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* 6–12 years of experience in Oracle Transportation Management (OTM), with at least 2–3 full lifecycle implementations.
* Strong knowledge of OTM functional configurations and technical architecture.
* Hands-on experience with SQL, PL/SQL, and OTM-related data structures.
* Expertise in OTM Cloud, automation agents, and customizations. Familiarity with integration frameworks, external distance/rate engines, and BI Publisher reporting.
* Strong understanding of logistics and supply chain processes. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
