description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Consulting – Banking & Capital Markets: Finacle Core Banking**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This document covers two role profiles for Finacle Core Banking transformation programs: Techno-Functional Consultant – Manager and Business Analyst – Senior.
  
  
**Role Profile: Business Analyst – Senior**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a functional and techno-functional Business Analyst with prior experience in Infosys Finacle Core Banking. The role focuses on requirements management, solution mapping, process modelling, data analysis, integration and API requirements, interface specifications, and banking data structures across Finacle implementation, transformation, migration, upgrade and modernization programs.
  
  
**Role Business Analyst – Finacle Core Banking**
**Experience 5+ years in banking; 3+ years in business analysis**
**Domain Retail and Corporate Banking, Lending, Payments and Cards, Compliance, Treasury, Investment Banking and Wealth Management**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work as a Business Analyst in banking transformation projects.
* Conduct requirements workshops and stakeholder discussions with business and technology teams.
* Gather, analyze, document and validate business, functional and non-functional requirements.
* Prepare BRDs, FSDs, user stories, process flows, use cases, data mapping documents and test scenarios.
* Perform solution mapping and gap analysis between business requirements and Finacle capabilities.
* Coordinate with Solution Architecture, Development, Testing, Infrastructure and Vendor teams.
* Support data mapping, migration analysis, integration requirements and reconciliation activities.
* Ensure alignment among business requirements, solution design, testing activities and business objectives.
* Support SIT, UAT, Simulation, Go-Live and Hypercare from business and functional perspectives.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Finacle Core Banking functionality and ecosystem, including parameterization and configuration impacts.
* Experience in requirements elicitation, business process modelling, functional design, fit-gap analysis and process transformation.
* Understanding of APIs, web services, interface specifications, integration touchpoints, banking data models and data mapping.
* Experience supporting data migration, reconciliation, validation, reporting, audit and regulatory data requirements.
* Exposure to digital and mobile banking, channel integrations, microservices, cloud, DevOps and modern banking technologies.
* Experience designing Java-based extensions, services and integration flows using Finacle Integrator and API Hub on Finacle 11x.
* Experience developing and customizing front-end interfaces, menus and client-side components for Finacle 11x.
* Strong knowledge of Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Payments, Lending, Treasury, Liquidity, Finance, Risk, Compliance and regulatory processes.
* Client-facing communication, documentation, presentation, analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* MBA, MCA, BE, BTech or equivalent qualification with banking industry experience.
* Business Analysis or banking domain certification such as CBAP, CCBA or ECBA.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Exposure to Finacle Digital Banking, Payments, API Banking and Open Banking initiatives.
* Familiarity with SQL, reporting, reconciliation, UML, BPMN, Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
* Experience using Generative AI and prompt engineering.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Our Commitment
  
  
**As a commitment,**
we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How To Apply**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Informatica MDM & IDQ Developer – MDM Hub & ActiveVOS
description:
Senior Informatica MDM \& IDQ Developer – MDM Hub \& ActiveVOS
 



 Experience\- 5–10 Years
 



 Employment Type\- Full\-Time
 



 Work Location\- Remote
 



 Notice Period\- Immediate
 



 About the Role
 



 We are seeking an experienced Senior Informatica MDM \& IDQ Developer with strong hands\-on expertise in Informatica Multidomain MDM, MDM Hub Console, Informatica Data Quality (IDQ/CDQ), and ActiveVOS.
 



 The ideal candidate should be a strong technical resource who can work directly within the MDM Hub Console, understand business requirements, configure and develop MDM solutions, build and customize match/merge and survivorship logic, and develop ActiveVOS workflows for data stewardship and approval processes.
 



 This is a hands\-on development and configuration role requiring deep knowledge of Informatica MDM architecture, MDM Hub configuration, data quality, integration, and workflow development.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Informatica MDM Development \& Configuration
 


* Work extensively with the Informatica MDM Hub Console for configuration, development, testing, and deployment.
* Configure and develop Base Objects, Landing Tables, Staging Tables, Mappings, Packages, Queries, Tokens, Match Rules, Merge Rules, and Trust/Survivorship Rules.
* Design and implement MDM solutions based on business and data governance requirements.
* Configure match and merge strategies, including deterministic and probabilistic matching.
* Configure trust, validation, survivorship, and consolidation rules.
* Develop and maintain Business Entity Services (BES) and associated MDM services.
* Configure and maintain Hub Jobs, batch processes, load jobs, tokenization, and cleanse processes.
* Troubleshoot data processing, matching, merging, and consolidation issues within the MDM Hub.
* Perform MDM configuration changes, enhancements, testing, and production deployments.



 ActiveVOS Workflow Development
 


* Design, develop, configure, and maintain ActiveVOS workflows integrated with Informatica MDM.
* Develop workflows for data stewardship, approvals, exception handling, and business processes.
* Configure ActiveVOS tasks, business processes, rules, notifications, and assignments.
* Integrate ActiveVOS workflows with MDM Hub and Business Entity Services.
* Troubleshoot workflow failures, stuck tasks, integration issues, and process bottlenecks.
* Customize workflows based on changing business and data governance requirements.



 Informatica Data Quality (IDQ/CDQ)
 


* Develop and maintain data quality mappings, transformations, cleansing, standardization, and validation rules.
* Work with profiling, scorecards, reference data, and reusable data quality components.
* Configure and maintain AddressDoctor and address cleansing/standardization processes.
* Identify data quality issues and implement appropriate remediation and cleansing strategies.
* Integrate IDQ capabilities with MDM processes to improve data accuracy and consistency.



 Integration \& API Development
 


* Develop and support integrations between Informatica MDM and upstream/downstream applications.
* Work with REST/SOAP APIs, Business Entity Services, web services, and application integrations.
* Configure and troubleshoot MDM data publishing and integration processes.
* Work with ETL/data integration processes for loading and synchronizing master data.
* Troubleshoot integration failures and performance issues across MDM and connected systems.



 Production Support \& Performance
 


* Monitor MDM processes, workflows, integrations, and scheduled jobs.
* Analyze and resolve production issues related to MDM Hub, IDQ, and ActiveVOS.
* Perform root\-cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.
* Optimize match rules, mappings, queries, batch processes, and workflows for better performance.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, database, application, and vendor teams when required.
* Support deployment, release management, upgrades, patches, and migration activities.



 Required Skills \& Experience
 


* 5–10 years of overall IT/data management experience, with significant hands\-on experience in Informatica MDM.
* Strong hands\-on development and configuration experience with Informatica Multidomain MDM / Informatica MDM Hub.
* Must have extensive experience working directly with the MDM Hub Console.
* Strong understanding of MDM configuration, development, match/merge, survivorship, trust, validation, and consolidation.
* Strong hands\-on experience with ActiveVOS workflow development and administration.
* Experience developing and maintaining MDM Business Entity Services (BES).
* Strong experience with Informatica Data Quality (IDQ/CDQ).
* Good understanding of Informatica MDM architecture and data model.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or Snowflake.
* Experience with REST/SOAP APIs and web\-service integrations.
* Good understanding of ETL/data integration concepts.
* Experience with Linux/Unix environments and shell scripting.
* Ability to troubleshoot application, database, integration, and MDM\-related issues independently.



 Candidate Profile
 



 The ideal candidate should be:
 


* A hands\-on Informatica MDM developer/configurator, not purely an administrator.
* Comfortable navigating the MDM Hub Console and independently configuring and developing MDM components.
* Strong in ActiveVOS workflow development and MDM workflow integration.
* Able to understand complex master\-data requirements and convert them into technical MDM solutions.
* Strong in troubleshooting, debugging, performance tuning, and production support.
* Capable of working independently with business, data governance, integration, and technical teams.



 Core Technical Skills
 



 Primary:
 



 Informatica MDM Hub \| MDM Hub Console \| ActiveVOS \| Informatica IDQ/CDQ \| Match \& Merge \| Survivorship \| Trust Rules \| Business Entity Services \| Data Stewardship Workflows

 We are seeking a Senior Salesforce CPQ Business Systems Analyst (Techno\-Functional) to lead solution design and delivery for complex Quote\-to\-Cash (QTC) transformation initiatives. In this role, you will bridge business strategy and hands\-on technical architecture—translating SaaS subscription models, multi\-product bundles, and data workflows into scalable Salesforce CPQ configurations and integration specifications. * Account Onboarding, MDM \& Routing: Design account creation and approval workflows. Configure territory and user routing based on geography, revenue, and employee headcount.
* Integration \& Data Architecture: Partner with engineering teams to define integration specs between Salesforce CPQ, Master Data Management (Informatica MDM), middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi), and downstream invoicing engines. Define the Salesforce and Informatica MDM integration for account validation, enrichment, and deduplication. This includes resolving conflicts between third\-party data (ZoomInfo, D\&B, SEC) and existing MDM records.
* Data \& Technical Validation: Write SOQL queries to analyze data models, troubleshoot configuration edge cases, and validate data migrations/enrichment pipelines.
* AI \& Emerging Tech: Assist in evaluating and setting up native AI capabilities (e.g., Salesforce Agentforce, sub\-agents) to automate internal workflows and user journeys.
* Agile Story Authoring: Write detailed user stories, process flow diagrams, and acceptance criteria while partnering with offshore development teams to drive sprint execution.


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience: 8\+ years of experience in the Salesforce ecosystem, with at least 4\+ years dedicated to Salesforce CPQ (SteelBrick) implementation and business analysis.
* CPQ Expertise: Hands\-on mastery of Salesforce CPQ configurations—including complex product rules, pricing waterfalls, price rules, and subscription management.
* Integration Knowledge: Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns, REST/SOAP APIs, and tools such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica MDM.
* Technical Acumen: Ability to write SOQL queries, read APEX data structures, and understand complex object relationships within Salesforce.
* Process Mastery: Deep functional understanding of Quote\-to\-Cash, SaaS billing models, and contract lifecycle workflows.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 




  





**EternUp is building the digital twin for human life — an AI operating system that connects your time, work, relationships, health, knowledge and finances into one continuously evolving model of you. Powered by Continuo, our personal context layer, EternUp understands not just what you ask for, but what's happening and what should happen next — then acts on it through Aeon, an AI chief of staff that coordinates specialized agents across your calendar, tasks, health, and logistics. We're the human side of a two\-sided platform: the same digital\-twin technology powers Twinamics for businesses. This is a new category, not a calendar app or a wellness tracker — and we're building the infrastructure for it from the ground up.** 




  





**Role Description** 




**As a Founding Engineer at EternUp, you'll design, build, and scale the core systems behind our digital twin: the context layer that ingests and models a person's life, the agent runtime that lets Aeon act safely on their behalf, and the day\-design and task systems users touch every day. You'll work across a modern stack (Next.js/React, Postgres, agentic AI orchestration) and collaborate directly with the founders to turn product and architectural decisions into shipped, tested code. Day to day, this means high\-quality backend and full\-stack work, sound engineering judgment on what an autonomous agent should and shouldn't be allowed to do, and end\-to\-end ownership of features from spec to production. This is a full\-time hybrid role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, with a mix of on\-site collaboration and flexible work\-from\-home days.** 




  





**Qualifications** 



* Full\-stack engineering: strong TypeScript/JavaScript, React/Next.js on the frontend, Node/Postgres on the backend — able to build and ship a feature end\-to\-end alone
* GUI/frontend craft: can build clean, responsive interfaces from scratch and implement a design system precisely (spacing, typography, states) — not just plug in a component library
* Agentic systems, built not bolted on: has built agent loops, tool\-calling, or orchestration logic from open\-source frameworks or from scratch (LangGraph, CrewAI, custom loops) — not just prompting a hosted API and calling it done
* Actuator/automation layer: experience building systems that take real\-world actions on a user's behalf — action registries, permission gating, execution logs — using self\-hosted or open\-source tooling (e.g., browser automation via Playwright/CDP, not a paid automation SaaS)
* Open\-source\-first instinct: default to self\-hosting and open\-source stacks (Postgres, open LLMs where viable, open queues/workers, open auth) over proprietary APIs and managed SaaS wherever it's practical
* CI/CD and infra: can set up and maintain build/test/deploy pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar), containerization (Docker), and basic cloud infra without hand\-holding
* Systems/backend depth: comfortable with databases, auth, queues, and API design — not just frontend\-adjacent scripting
* Startup ownership: writes production\-quality code fast, debugs down to root cause, and takes a feature from idea to deployed without needing a spec for every detail

description:
**Role Title: AVP, Security Automation Senior Developer (L10\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.
   

  

* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best\-in\-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work\-life integration and overall well\-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities, focusing on Advancing Diverse Talent to take up leadership roles.


**Organizational Overview**
 This Role deals with in\-house software development for InfoSec groups (primarily, but not exclusively, for Cyber Operations personnel). Our services are currently engaged by the JSOC, IAM, Insider Risk, Digitial Risk, Cyber Threat Intel, and Advanced Threat Response teams, among others. Our solutions are deployed within two enterprise tools: Cortex XSOAR and YODA. Both tools require Python HTTP client programming expertise. We uphold an Agile software engineering / project planning discipline where our customers control their own automation road maps.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The role of the Security Automation Senior Developer involves developing and maintaining automated processes that help to minimize cyber risk by improving the organization's ability to identify and respond to threats in an efficient manner. The team\-member will partner with members of cyber operations, information security and the larger business to design, develop, test, and deploy strong automation use\-cases. Ideal candidates will have strong Python HTTP client programming skill sets with knowledge of cyber detection concepts/strategies and security tools. More so, the ideal candidate will be capable of critical thinking and problem solving with a customer\-first attitude.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with technology leaders in adherence to technology strategy and roadmap.
* Skillfully gather and analyze requirements from requesting parties and stakeholders.
* Design, develop, and release new use cases to maximize the benefits and efficiencies from a SOAR platform.
* Develop automations using no\-code, low\-code, and traditional code approaches, in that order.
* Engineer for software quality through sound manual and automated testing, peer review, and customer acceptance.
* Develop and maintain custom security apps and tools via python web development.
* Improve performance and efficiency of existing automation solutions.
* Participate in diagnosing and resolving production support issues as directed.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor’s degree with 4 to 5\+ years of software engineering within Information Security or Intelligence contexts; OR in lieu of degree, 6 to 7\+ years of software engineering within Information Security or Intelligence contexts
* Demonstrated competence in Python, particularly HTTP client programming.
* SOAR platform engineering and development preferred.
* Intimate familiarity with the Agile Manifesto preferred.
* Able to communicate complex information, concepts, or ideas in a confident and well\-organized manner through verbal, written, and/or visual means.


**Desired Skills \& Knowledge**
* Applicable Information Security professional certifications (e.g., SANS, AWS Security and Developer based certifications) and tool\-specific certifications.
* Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
* Highly analytical, detail\-oriented, and strong problem solving with a common\-sense approach to resolving problems.
* Expertise to clearly define complex issues despite incomplete or ambiguous information.
* Strong oral and written communications skills.
* Strong interpersonal and critical thinking skills.
* Prior SOC, cyber intelligence, or incident response experience is a plus.


**Eligibility Criteria**
 Bachelor’s degree with 4 to 5\+ years of software engineering within Information Security or Intelligence contexts; OR in lieu of degree, 6 to 7\+ years of software engineering within Information Security or Intelligence contexts
   

  

**Work Timings:** 
**4:00 AM to 12:00 PM ET**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs)
   

  

 We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad
   

  

 Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

* L8\+ Employees can apply

title: Technical Lead - VIM for SAP
description:
**Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd \| Business Area: Information Services (IT)**
 Technical Lead \- VIM for SAP
   

  

**Kolkata, West Bengal, India \| Workplace Type: On\-Site \| Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE \| Reference Code: req32591**
 It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
   

  

 The Technical Lead in this position will be responsible for all solution components of the Vendor Invoice Management solution. And contribute to configuration, continuous improvements and standardizations of VIM solutions across SAP systems with the objective to optimize exception, approval and blocked invoice workflows and to increase efficiencies and to maximize the level of automation of the full end\-to\-end process.
   

  

 At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on\-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
   

  

 Team
   

  

 Making an impact. What will you do?
   

  

* The Technical Lead will be responsible for handling the incident \& problem resolution (3rd level support) within defined SLAs and set priorities in close collaboration with Corporate IT and regional IT teams (2nd level support) and with business stakeholders in regions EMEA and APAC Regression testing \& regression test support during major releases and system upgrades
* And support the development of automated tests
* Also, gather and analyze business requirements, translate these requirements into functional and technical scope and functional specifications
* Ans also, design, build and implement improvements and new functional solutions for Vendor Invoice Management processes in SAP based on state\-of\-the\-art SAP standard system capabilities and technical standards, complying with Linde IT standards and IT strategy and fully meeting business requirements
* You will also be required to identify opportunities for process improvements, efficiencies and cost reductions, leveraging S/4Hana capabilities and new VIM functionality
* And coordinate the implementation of new VIM functionality in SAP ECC and S/4Hana Systems according to Linde plc project management guidelines
* You must contribute in knowledge transfer/guidance to and training preparation and delivery for IT and business stakeholders of new IT functionalities and IT solutions
* And collaborate and consult with business and IT teams or stakeholders and manage external service providers to deliver highly dependable, secure, and integrated solutions meeting compliance requirements to the business
* Lastly, cross\-skilling team members to allow growth of team members, distribution of knowledge across team members and a more flexible work allocation.


 Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
   

  

* You must have a bachelor's degree in business informatics, Business Administration, or equivalent qualification
* And Global Certification(s) in Vendor Invoice Management for SAP® Solutions, S/4 Hana implementation experience required, ITIL Certification preferred
* A must is also 6\+ years of experience in technical design, implementation and support of international large\-scale systems in Vendor Invoice Management for SAP® Solutions (VIM), at a minimum experience in two end\-to\-end large scale VIM implementations.
* Along with Experience in working with onshore as well as offshore teams
* Knowledge on extensive skills in the implementation and optimization of Vendor Invoice Management for SAP® Solutions (up to most up\-to\-date versions in SAP ECC and S/4Hana) and in the set\-up, administration and optimization of Invoice Capture for SAP
* Must is In\-depth knowledge of SAP and VIM standard functionalities with the aim to minimise programming


 Why you will love working for us!
   

  

 Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high\-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals \& energy, food \& beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra\-high\-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life\-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state\-of\-the\-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
   

  

 Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006\. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
   

  

 At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
   

  

 Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
   

  

 For more information about the company and its products and services, please visit linde.com

title: Unity Game Developer – Multiplayer Strategy Game
description:
**Company:** 
 Excellis IT Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience Required:** 
 Minimum 2 Years
 



  





 Excellis IT is looking for an experienced
 **Unity Game Developer** 
 to work on the development of a confidential cross\-platform multiplayer strategy game.
 



  





 The game is being developed for
 **Web, Android, and iOS** 
 and involves multiplayer sessions, rule\-based gameplay, player actions, card and board interactions, resource/economy management, game states, events, scoring, progression, animations, and real\-time interaction between players.
 



 Due to client confidentiality, the project name and detailed gameplay mechanics will be shared only with shortlisted candidates at the appropriate stage of the selection process.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 The selected developer will be responsible for developing the actual gameplay and game systems in Unity, including:
 


* Develop the game using
 **Unity and C\#**
* **Implement complete gameplay logic based on the approved Game Design Document**
* **Develop multiplayer game rooms and player\-session flows**
* **Build game\-state management systems**
* **Implement player actions, rules, scoring, progression, and winning conditions**
* **Develop digital board/card\-based interactions and event\-driven gameplay**
* **Implement turn/session\-based and real\-time gameplay systems as required**
* **Develop systems for player resources, virtual assets, inventory, scores, and in\-game calculations**
* **Implement event\-based changes and game\-rule conditions**
* **Develop flows such as:**
* **Lobby**
* **Match creation**
* **Player joining**
* **Game setup**
* **Active gameplay**
* **Event resolution**
* **Round/session transitions**
* **Results**
* **Game completion**
* **Integrate game UI/UX created by the design team**
* **Implement gameplay animations, card movements, board interactions, transitions, and visual feedback**
* **Integrate 2D and 3D game assets**
* **Work with Unity Animator, Timeline, particle systems, and other animation systems**
* **Integrate game audio and sound effects**
* **Integrate REST APIs and backend services**
* **Implement WebSocket or similar real\-time communication**
* **Synchronize player actions and game states across multiple devices**
* **Handle reconnect, disconnect, timeout, inactivity, and interrupted\-session scenarios**
* **Develop tutorial, onboarding, and guided gameplay systems**
* **Implement AI/bot\-controlled player behaviour where required**
* **Optimise the game for WebGL, Android, and iOS**
* **Test and debug gameplay, multiplayer synchronization, and performance issues**
* **Work closely with Game Designers, UI/UX Designers, 3D Artists, Backend Developers, QA, and Project Managers**
* **Maintain scalable, reusable, and well\-structured code**
* **Follow proper Git/version\-control practices**



  





**Mandatory Requirements** 




  




* **Minimum 2 years of professional experience as a Unity Game Developer**
* **Strong hands\-on experience with Unity**
* **Strong knowledge of C\#**
* **Good understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming**
* **Experience with Unity GameObjects, Components, Prefabs, and Scenes**
* **Experience with ScriptableObjects**
* **Experience with Coroutines**
* **Good understanding of Events and Delegates**
* **Experience with Unity UI / Canvas system**
* **Experience with Unity Animator and animation integration**
* **Experience integrating 2D and 3D game assets**
* **Strong understanding of gameplay programming**
* **Experience with game\-state management**
* **Experience with REST API integration**
* **Experience handling JSON/data\-driven systems**
* **Experience with Git/version control**



  





**Multiplayer Experience** 




 Candidates should have practical understanding of:
 


* Client\-server game architecture
* Multiplayer game rooms
* Player joining and session management
* Real\-time synchronization
* Game\-state synchronization
* WebSockets
* Disconnect and reconnect handling

Your role spans the full solution lifecycle — assessing client needs and data, selecting and customizing models (including Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models), designing scalable data and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines for training and production, and ensuring quality, value, and reliability of deployed systems.

 Implement and maintain efficient data storage and retrieval mechanisms for models and knowledge using appropriate tools

 Collaborate with teams from both business and technical sides, including users, use case representatives, business owners, engineers, architects, and UI designers, to achieve end\-to\-end project goals and integrate into production
   

  

 Bachelor's Degree or equivalent
   

  

 Minimum of 5 years of experience as a machine learning engineer or scientist, deploying models in production at scale , including monitoring, alerting, automatic bug filing and auditing.
   

  

 Minimum of 5 years of experience in applying theoretical foundations of computer science, including computer system architecture, system engineering, and programming
   

  

 Minimum of 3 years of experience in distributed computing systems and architecture that may include big data, high\-performance compute, engineering simulations, scientific compute, grid and cloud computing, distributed networks
   

  

 Minimum of 2 years of experience in building and deploying AI/ML based software to a cloud environment.
   

  

 Proficiency in Python and python\-based AI/ML framework and familiarity with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)..
   

  

 Experience working with language models like LLM's APIs and optimizing their usage for specific applications.
   

  

 Experience with the following programming languages: Python, C\+\+, Java, R, SQL
   

  

 Strong written \& verbal communication skills and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders
   

  

 Strong client\-facing skillsets in a consulting environment
   

  

 Strong cross\-functional skills with the ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and client\-side teams
   

  

 Entrepreneurial mindset with a curiosity and passion for emergent tech and driving innovation
   

  

 MS or PhD in related field preferred (computer science, engineering, etc.)
   

  

 As a Large Language Model Architect, a typical day involves designing and structuring advanced language models capable of understanding and generating human\-like text. This role requires envisioning the architecture of neural networks that are trained on extensive datasets, ensuring the models can effectively process natural language. The workday includes analyzing model performance, refining parameters, and collaborating with various teams to integrate these models into broader applications. Continuous innovation and problem\-solving are key aspects, as the architect shapes the future capabilities of language\-based artificial intelligence systems.

**Key skills:**

* Experience with logging and monitoring tools such as Splunk, ELK, Dynatrace, Grafana, Cloud Monitoring, or equivalent platforms.
* Knowledge of CI/CD tools including Jenkins, GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Maven, and automated deployment pipelines.
* Experience working with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (preferred), AWS, or Azure.
* Understanding of API Governance, API Analytics, Developer Portals, and API Lifecycle Management.
* Multi\-domain expertise and experience with other integration platforms is an added advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Apigee API Engineer Certification or related Google Cloud certifications are preferred.
* Should be capable of mentoring team members and handling customer interactions independently.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team\-player and self\-started attitude.
* Ability to create quality process documentation.
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.

* Strong understanding of API Security, API Governance, and Enterprise Integration Patterns.
* Experience handling production support, incident management, and root cause analysis.
* Ability to manage technical risks and customer escalations.
* Ability to interact effectively across business, technical, and leadership teams.

**Additionally, Good To Have**

* Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka or Pub/Sub.
* Knowledge of project management tools like JIRA, Azure DevOps, and Confluence.
* Exposure to DevOps automation, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and cloud\-native architectures.
* Knowledge of SDLC, Waterfall, Agile, SAFe Agile, and Scrum methodologies.
* Experience with API monetization and partner onboarding solutions.
* Understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and digital transformation programs.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Ability to define processes for teams.
* Experience in project audits and reviews.
* Ability to analyse risks and metrics of projects.


**What We Look For**

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

**EY \| Building a better working world**

 What if the code you write could directly shape how the next generation of AI understands and generates software? We're looking for Software Engineers in Kolkata to build, evaluate, and improve AI\-generated code — helping train AI systems to think like real developers.
   

  

 You'll write solutions, review AI outputs, and provide the expert\-level feedback that makes AI coding assistants smarter, safer, and more reliable. This is hands\-on engineering work at the frontier of AI development — not theoretical, not bureaucratic, and not boring.

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Write, debug, and optimize code across a range of languages, frameworks, and problem domains
* Review and evaluate AI\-generated code for correctness, efficiency, readability, and best practices
* Identify bugs, logic errors, security issues, and performance bottlenecks in AI outputs
* Provide structured, detailed feedback explaining why code works — or doesn't
* Design challenging coding prompts and edge\-case scenarios to stress\-test AI capabilities
* Compare and rank multiple AI\-generated solutions based on engineering quality
* Work independently and asynchronously — fully on your own schedule


**Who You Are**
* Proficient in one or more programming languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, C\+\+, Go, TypeScript, or similar)
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles
* Able to read, write, and reason about code with clarity and precision
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and a systematic debugging approach
* Clear written communicator — you can explain technical decisions in plain language
* Self\-motivated and reliable when working independently without supervision
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience


**Nice to Have**
* Experience across multiple languages or tech stacks (full\-stack, backend, systems, data engineering)
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, LLMs, or prompt engineering
* Background in code review, technical writing, or mentoring junior developers
* Experience with cloud platforms, DevOps, or distributed systems
* Competitive programming, open\-source contributions, or side projects that demonstrate your craft
* Advanced degree in Computer Science or related discipline


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and work from anywhere
* Freelance autonomy with intellectually stimulating, high\-impact work
* Directly influence how AI writes, understands, and reasons about code
* Sharpen your own engineering skills by evaluating diverse problems daily
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Senior Software Engineer – VoIP / SIP
description:
**Role:** 
 Senior Software Engineer – VoIP / SIP
 



**Function:** 
 Software Engineering / Telephony Infrastructure
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata / Gurugram
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 AI, Medical SaaS, Dental Medical SaaS
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company builds medical AI SaaS for the U.S. dental market.
 



 Thousands of dental practices across North America rely on its platform daily. It unifies analytics, scheduling, communications, payments, and marketing automation into one system.
 



 The platform automates admin work and gives teams real\-time visibility into revenue and retention. Founded in 2015 by a practicing dentist, a data strategist, and a PhD technologist.
 



 The company is mission\-driven, execution\-oriented, and moving fast in a large, under\-digitized healthcare vertical.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 This role owns the design and implementation of the company's core VoIP/SIP telephony backbone — the infrastructure layer that powers calling, routing, and communication workflows for thousands of dental practices. The engineer will architect and build carrier\-grade SIP services in Golang on top of open\-source components, and integrate the telephony stack with the company's broader AI\-first SaaS platform. The role reports to the Engineering India Head and sits at the intersection of deep infrastructure work and product\-facing impact.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and implement a carrier\-grade SIP/VoIP core using Kamailio or OpenSIPS for SIP signaling and FreeSWITCH or similar for media and application services.
* Build Golang\-based SIP services — registrar, SBC\-like components, routing logic, monitoring daemons — and internal APIs to control routing, policies, and provisioning.
* Configure and operate SIP load balancing, failover, and high\-availability setups across multi\-node SIP proxies, distributed media servers, and RTP proxies.
* Implement and maintain dial plans, least\-cost routing, DID management, class\-4/class\-5 switching logic, and integrations with upstream carriers and PSTN gateways.
* Own security and robustness of the VoIP stack: TLS/SRTP, authentication, rate limiting, fraud detection hooks, and abuse controls.
* Integrate the telephony backbone with the company's SaaS platform via well\-defined internal APIs and webhooks, covering user accounts, billing, analytics, and AI/automation flows.
* Define and own monitoring, alerting, logging, and capacity planning for SIP signaling, RTP/media, and VoIP quality metrics (MOS, jitter, packet loss).



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–10 years of software development experience with at least 4–5 years building or operating large\-scale VoIP/SIP systems in production.
* Strong Golang skills including high\-performance networked services, concurrent processing, and production\-grade APIs.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one open\-source SIP server — Kamailio, OpenSIPS, or Asterisk — including configuration, routing logic, and packet\-level troubleshooting.
* Deep understanding of SIP, RTP, SDP, NAT traversal, registrar/registration flows, B2BUA vs. proxy behavior, and SBC concepts.
* Proven ability to design and operate highly available telephony backbones: clustering, health checks, load balancing, and graceful failover.
* Strong Linux and networking fundamentals — iptables, firewalls, TCP/UDP, QoS — with comfort debugging at packet level using tcpdump or Wireshark.
* Experience integrating VoIP platforms with RESTful backends and databases (PostgreSQL or MariaDB/MySQL) and message queues for control and billing workflows.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience with WebRTC, SIP over WebSockets, and browser or mobile softphone integrations.
* Familiarity with VoIP billing, rating engines, CDR processing, and reseller hierarchies (class\-4/class\-5 softswitch products or similar).
* Cloud\-native deployment of VoIP stacks — containerized Kamailio or FreeSWITCH clusters on AWS or GCP, Kubernetes, service meshes.
* Prior work building call center or CPaaS\-style platforms including programmable IVRs, call queues, and analytics.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of a mission\-critical infrastructure layer powering thousands of live dental practices across North America.
* Direct exposure to AI\-first product evolution — conversational automation, intelligent call routing, and front\-office workflow integration.
* High\-autonomy environment with tight cross\-functional collaboration across product, engineering, and operations.
* Flexible scheduling within a fast\-moving, execution\-oriented team with real, measurable impact.

title: Senior Power BI Engineer
description:
We are building a centralised marketing and sales analytics platform for a large multi\-market consumer brand: a governed BigQuery data layer feeding a single, certified Power BI reporting product used by head\-office marketing and sales teams and by every national market. It replaces a fragmented estate of hand\-built, per\-market dashboards and manual spreadsheet exports with one version of the truth.
   

  

 You will own the Power BI half of that platform end to end — the semantic model, the KPI logic, every report page, and the executive PDF report generated from it. This is not a dashboard\-assembly role. One model and one report template must serve every market through filtering, hold up under executive scrutiny, and reconcile to source platforms on demand.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 6\+ Years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Kolkata (Onsite)
   

  

**‍Key Responsibilities**
 ‍
   

  

**Strategic Marketing \& Brand Building**
* Design, build and own the certified Power BI semantic model over a governed star schema in the cloud warehouse — relationships, cardinality, role\-playing dates, hierarchies and field\-level documentation.
* Choose and justify the connectivity approach (Import, DirectQuery or composite), and implement incremental refresh, aggregations and partitioning to keep refresh windows and query response inside agreed service levels.
* Author the KPI layer in DAX: a frozen, documented catalogue of measures covering traffic, engagement, conversion and funnel performance, with consistent year\-on\-year, year\-to\-date, quarter\-on\-quarter and custom period\-comparison logic.
* Implement weighted and normalised benchmark measures so small and large markets can be compared fairly against a group average.
* Keep the model performant and maintainable — calculation groups, variables, disciplined measure structure, and regular tuning with Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio and Tabular Editor.


 ‍
   

  

**Report And Experience Design**
* Build the report pages the business actually asked for: a real\-time KPI tracker with progress\-to\-target visuals, market\-versus\-group benchmarking, product\-level performance, an end\-to\-end lead\-to\-order funnel with banded performance thresholds, channel and traffic\-source analysis, and social performance.
* Design for flexible self\-service: independent metric selection per visual, multi\-market comparison, switchable chart types, and free choice of reporting and comparison periods — without users needing to export anything.
* Apply a consistent, accessible visual language across every page: clear labelling, sensible visual hierarchy, and charts rather than dense tables.
* Configure workspaces, apps, audiences and deployment pipelines across development, test and production, and implement row\-level security where required.


 ‍
   

  

**Executive reporting layer**
* Build and automate the recurring executive PDF report generated directly from the platform, using paginated reports and export automation, so a market or period can be selected and a complete, correctly formatted pack produced in one action.
* Ensure exported visuals remain visuals — presentation\-ready output, not screenshots of tables.


 ‍
   

  

**Quality, reconciliation and trust**
* Build data quality and anomaly surfacing into the reporting layer: freshness indicators, missing\-period detection, and outlier alerting on unexpected drops or spikes.
* Reconcile platform figures against the underlying source platforms, document the variances that are structurally expected, and explain them clearly to non\-technical stakeholders before they are discovered in a meeting.
* Write and maintain the model and report documentation, KPI definitions and handover material.


 ‍
   

  

**Delivery**
* Work to a gated, fixed\-scope delivery plan with hard go\-live dates, translating business requirements into agreed KPI definitions and report specifications.
* Run user acceptance testing on a reference market, manage a controlled review\-and\-revision cycle per report page, and support training and handover.


 ‍
   

  

**‍Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 6\+ years in business intelligence or analytics engineering, with at least 4 years hands\-on in Power BI on production, business\-critical reporting.
* Advanced DAX — time intelligence, calculation groups, context transition, performance\-conscious measure design. You can explain why a measure is slow, not just that it is.
* Proven semantic model design over a dimensional warehouse: star schema, incremental refresh, composite models, aggregations, gateways and capacity considerations.
* Strong SQL, and practical experience querying a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred; Snowflake, Redshift or Synapse considered) with an understanding of partitioning, clustering and query cost.
* Direct experience modelling digital analytics data — particularly GA4 event\-level exports in a warehouse, including nested and repeated structures, sessionisation and conversion definitions. This is the single most important differentiator for this role.
* Paginated reports (Power BI Report Builder / RDL) and export automation for pixel\-accurate PDF output.
* Report and dashboard design judgement — you can take a vague executive requirement and produce something that answers it in seconds, and you can defend your layout decisions.
* Power Query / M for shaping and troubleshooting, and comfort with source\-control and deployment discipline.
* Confident written and spoken English, and the composure to present work directly to senior stakeholders and take feedback in the room.


 ‍
   

  

**Desirable**
* Marketing, media or e\-commerce measurement background — an understanding of what marketers and sales leadership actually need to see.
* Working knowledge of consent management and its effect on reported figures, and how modelled data behaves differently across interfaces and warehouse exports.
* Microsoft Fabric, Power BI Premium / Fabric capacity administration.
* Multi\-market or multi\-tenant reporting at scale, including row\-level security design.
* dbt or an equivalent transformation framework; Python for supporting automation.
* Custom or advanced visuals (for example Deneb / Vega\-Lite) where the standard library falls short.
* Relevant Microsoft certification (PL\-300 or equivalent) — useful, but the portfolio matters more.


 ‍
   

  

**Interview Process**
* Application review
* 5–10 minute initial screening call with the TA team
* Technical interviews {Domain specific}
* ‍Practical test conducted in the presence of a panel member
* ‍Role match \& offer

title: AVP,  Data Architect (L11)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Data Architect (L11\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.
* Define the target\-state Data \& AI Foundations architecture supporting agentic AI use cases, enterprise knowledge graph or metadata layer, data products, and AI\-ready datasets.
* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services
* Good understanding of AWS infrastructure concepts (networking, security, storage, compute) and how they apply to data and AI workloads.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, and integration technologies (e.g., CDC, APIs, event buses) for both batch and real\-time use cases.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary teams and influence across platform, AI, data, and business stakeholders.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**
* Experience implementing or leveraging knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or semantic search to power AI and RAG use cases.
* Solid understanding of LLM and agentic AI patterns (prompts, tools, RAG, memory) and how data quality and structure impact AI behavior and performance.
* Background in building data products specifically targeted for AI/ML (feature stores, labeled datasets, evaluation datasets, fine\-tuning corpora).
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF) as they apply to data and AI.
* Prior experience in financial services, credit, payments, or similar domains where data lineage, explainability, and audit trails are critical.
* Basic AWS solution architecture knowledge including core services, AWS S3, Redshift, Amazon Bedrock, and Bedrock AgentCore so they can collaborate effectively with platform and agent teams.
* Good understanding of enterprise data governance and access controls like AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data catalog and metadata management frameworks.
* Team player, strong engagement, positive attitude and natural curiosity are highly desired.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong familiarity with streaming through Kafka and other Data Lake technologies and techniques.
* Strong familiarity with data governance, data lineage, data processes, DML, and data architecture control execution
* Strong experience with business analysis \- Requirements analysis and conversion to data models.
* Must be able to develop creative solutions to problems.


**Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. title: EY - GDS Consulting - AIA - Mainframe - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced Manager – Mainframe Modernization to lead our AI\-Driven Legacy Transformation practice. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise across mainframe ecosystems, AI/ML\-driven modernization strategies, and cloud technologies, combined with strong leadership, stakeholder management, and team\-building capabilities to deliver large\-scale digital transformation programmes.
   

  

 You will own the end\-to\-end modernization strategy, drive cross\-functional collaboration with C\-suite leaders, business stakeholders, and architecture teams, and lead a team of engineers and specialists to successfully migrate mission\-critical mainframe workloads to modern, scalable, cloud\-native platforms using AI\-powered automation frameworks.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence:**
* Strategic Leadership and Stakeholder Management
+ Define and own the mainframe modernization strategy aligned with business objectives and enterprise technology roadmaps.
+ Collaborate with senior stakeholders, business leaders, and architecture teams to prioritise modernization initiatives and secure executive buy\-in.
+ Evaluate and recommend modernization paths — rehosting, refactoring, rebuilding, or replacing — based on cost\-benefit analysis, risk assessment, and business impact.

* Mainframe Systems Assessment and Governance
+ Oversee comprehensive assessments of mainframe applications (COBOL, JCL, VSAM, DB2, CICS, IMS, Assembler) to identify modernization opportunities, risks, and dependencies.
+ Establish governance frameworks, quality gates, and standards for modernization delivery across the portfolio.
+ Drive technical debt identification, quantification, and systematic reduction across the legacy estate.

* AI\-Driven Modernization and Automation
+ Champion the adoption of AI tools, LLMs, and custom AI agentic workflows for automated code analysis, refactoring, and code translation at scale.
+ Define and operationalise AI pipelines, prompt engineering standards, and context engineering best practices to maximise modernization throughput and accuracy.
+ Evaluate emerging AI/ML technologies and integrate them into the modernization toolchain to maintain competitive advantage.

* Team Leadership and Capability Building
+ Lead, mentor, and grow a team of mainframe modernization engineers, developers, and analysts.
+ Build team capabilities in AI\-driven modernization, cloud\-native development, and DevOps practices.
+ Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and provide technical guidance to ensure delivery excellence.

* Target\-State Architecture – APIs and Microservices
+ Architect and oversee the design of target\-state systems, including API integrations, microservices, and event\-driven architectures.
+ Ensure modernized solutions are scalable, resilient, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.

* Cloud and Platform Integration
+ Lead the migration of mainframe workloads to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) using AI\-driven and automated solutions.
+ Ensure seamless integration of legacy systems with cloud\-native services, containerised deployments (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
+ Drive adoption of infrastructure\-as\-code, observability, and security best practices for modernized workloads.

* Reporting, Documentation, and Business Impact
+ Create and present executive\-level reporting on modernization progress, business impact, risks, and ROI.
+ Maintain comprehensive technical documentation including system designs, AI pipeline architectures, and modernization roadmaps.
+ Track and communicate KPIs related to migration velocity, quality, cost savings, and operational efficiency.


**Skills and Attributes:**
* Educational Background
* Bachelor / master’s degree in computer science, AI, Any Engineering or quantitative background preferred.


**Professional Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience with legacy mainframe systems (COBOL, JCL, Assembler, CICS, DB2, IMS, VSAM) with at least 3–4 years in a leadership or managerial capacity.
* Proven track record of leading large\-scale mainframe modernization or digital transformation programmes.
* Deep expertise in data migration, integration, ETL, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
* Strong proficiency in programming/scripting languages (Python, Java, etc.).
* Expert\-level knowledge of APIs, microservices architecture, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Extensive experience with AI tools, LLM API calls, prompt engineering, and context engineering for automating code analysis and modernization workflows.
* Experience with enterprise modernization platforms (Micro Focus, AWS Mainframe Modernization, Azure Migrate, Google Cloud Dual Run) is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience building or managing AI/ML pipelines for code transformation at scale.


**Soft Skills**
* Exceptional client engagement and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into practical, high\-quality technical solutions.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership abilities.
* Experience with Agile/SAFe delivery methodologies and managing distributed/global teams.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Cloud certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP), AI/ML certifications, enterprise architecture (TOGAF), or mainframe\-related certifications are a plus.


**Why Join Us**
* Be at the forefront of AI\-driven mainframe modernization across enterprise clients.
* Work with global clients to drive real business impact through large\-scale digital transformation.
* Collaborate with a team of modernization experts, AI specialists, and industry leaders in a highly innovative and entrepreneurial environment.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, serving our clients locally and globally with innovation and at scale.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Tech & Data - System Transformation Data - Manager
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a Tech \& Data \- System Transformation Data \- Manager, you will play a pivotal role in assisting clients to develop solutions that enhance trust, drive improvement, and manage risk through advanced analytics and technology. Within our Assurance practice, you will focus on providing independent assessments of financial statements and internal controls, enhancing the credibility of information for stakeholders.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will utilize data wrangling technology and automation tools to establish processes that enable clients to make informed decisions based on accurate and trustworthy information.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Understanding Data Migration, data governance and data analytics.
* Experience / Exposure to System Transformation (Pre / Post Implementation)Projects for Audit / Non\-Audit clients
* Ability to leverage and possess hands\-on working knowledge of visualization software such as Power BI.
* Applying knowledge of data analysis and manipulation products like SQL, Alteryx, Python, and Databricks.
* Engaging in regulation, workforce, financial reporting, and automation.
* Managing complex internal and external stakeholder relationships.
* Thriving in a dynamic consulting environment, with a desire to grow within this setting.
* Managing client engagements and internal projects, including budgets, risks, and quality assurance.
* Preparing reports and deliverables for clients and other stakeholders.
* Developing and maintaining internal and external relationships.
* Identifying and pursuing business opportunities, supporting line management in proposal development, and managing, coaching, and supporting team members.
* Supporting team with engagement scoping and planning activities.
* Coaching team members in task completion.
* Performing advanced data analysis to support test procedures.
* Collaborating effectively with local and regional teams and clients.
* Supporting team in drafting client deliverables for review by Engagement Leaders.
* Managing project economics for engagement teams.
* Conducting basic review activities and providing coaching to junior team members.
* Demonstrates strong critical\-thinking ability to evaluate not just the presence of documentation but its quality, clarity, and completeness—proactively identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.


 What You Must Have
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering and Business, Financial Mathematics, Mathematical Economics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, or a related field.
* Minimum Years of Experience: 7\+ years of relevant experience, preferably in a public accounting firm or a large corporation
* 3 years of assurance experience in internal controls and/or business process testing.
* Experience in technology risk (e.g., IT General Controls, information security).
* Previous experience in shared service delivery centers.
* Certifications such as CIA, CISA, or ITIL are preferred.


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Advanced knowledge and understanding of financial risk management, operational risk management, and compliance requirements.
* Proficiency in data analytics tools (e.g., Alteryx, Power BI) and Microsoft suite tools (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Experience with major ERPs such as SAP, Oracle, and/or technology security management.
* Programming skills in SQL, Python, or R.
* Accounting experience and consulting experience.
* Knowledge in financial services is preferable.
* Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.

title: SAP ABAP on HANA Developer (8 to 10 years) - Kolkata
description:
We are hiring an experienced Lead SAP ABAP on HANA Developer (8 to 10 years) for Kolkata.
 



  





 Role Details\-
 



 • Role: SAP ABAP on HANA Developer
 



 • Experience: 8 to 10 Years
 



 • Location: Kolkata
 



 • Notice Period: Immediate to 15 days max
 



  





 What you will be working on:
 



 • Developing and enhancing ABAP programs in SAP S/4HANA utilizing modern code\-pushdown techniques, CDS Views, and AMDP.
 



 • Designing and building end\-to\-end RICEFW objects (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms).
 



 • Creating, customizing, and maintaining ABAP Data Dictionary (DDIC) objects including tables, views, structures, data elements, and domains.
 



 • Developing and consuming OData services for UI integration, alongside building complex ALV reports, Smart Forms, and Adobe Forms.
 



 • Conducting code reviews, performance tuning, and debugging aligned with SAP S/4HANA clean core standards.
 



  





 What we are looking for:
 



 • 8 to 10 years of strong hands\-on development experience in SAP ABAP and ABAP on HANA / S/4HANA.
 



 • Solid expertise in CDS Views, AMDP, and code optimization strategies.
 



 • Proven track record delivering standard and custom RICEFW solutions across core functional modules.
 



 • Hands\-on proficiency in OData service implementation and Adobe Forms / Smart Forms design.
 



 • Strong debugging, performance optimization, and analytical skills.
 



 • Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
 



  





 How to Apply:
 



 Please email your resume directly to: rmt@gruenbleen.com
 



  





 Email Subject Line format:
 



 SAP ABAP Developer \- Kolkata \- \[Your Name] \- \[Experience] \- \[Notice Period]
 



  





 \#SAPABAP \#ABAPonHANA \#SAPS4HANA \#CDSViews \#AMDP \#OData \#AdobeForms \#RICEFW \#KolkataJobs \#Hiring \#ImmediateJoiner
